data.text: I commit to catch 15 tons today and donate the $15,000 proceeds to the clinic. I’ll also catch no more than six tons next month so we can rebuild the stock, then return to ten each once the lake is back at capacity. My family’s livelihood has depended on this lake, and our neighbors depend on that clinic. Let’s record everyone’s catches and confirm the donation reaches the clinic today. Emma, are you willing to join both commitments?
